Here, $E$ is a $2\times 4$ matrix and $F$ is a $4\times 2$ matrix. 

There are $4$ columns in $E$ and $4$ rows in $F,$ so $E$ and $F$ are conformable for multiplication:

$$
{E}_{2\times \boxed{\text{4}}}{\cdot }_{✓}{F}_{\boxed{\text{4}}\times 2}={EF}_{2\times 2}
$$

Let's compute $EF,$ one element at a time:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 4 & 5 \\ 3 & -1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ -3 & -1 \\ -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,2=1\cdot 4+(-2)\cdot (-3)+4\cdot (-2)+5\cdot 0 \\  & [\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 4 & 5 \\ 3 & -1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ -3 & -1 \\ -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 & 18 \\ ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,18=1\cdot 2+(-2)\cdot (-1)+4\cdot 1+5\cdot 2 \\  & [\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 4 & 5 \\ 3 & -1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ -3 & -1 \\ -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 & 18 \\ 15 & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,15=3\cdot 4+(-1)\cdot (-3)+0\cdot (-2)+1\cdot 0 \\  & [\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 4 & 5 \\ 3 & -1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ -3 & -1 \\ -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 & 18 \\ 15 & 9\end{aligned}], &  & \,9=3\cdot 2+(-1)\cdot (-1)+0\cdot 1+1\cdot 2\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 
$EF=[\begin{aligned}2 & 18 \\ 15 & 9\end{aligned}].$
